summary: Iteration 3 full-stack regression + new-feature tests for RetOps rebrand, AI Agent Scoring, and Public Share. Backend: added 5 new pytest cases (auth guard on POST /api/playbooks/share/{customer}, 16-char hex token, idempotency same-user/same-customer, public GET /api/shared/playbook/{token}, 404 on invalid token). All 26 tests PASS against public backend URL. UI: drove Playwright with seeded session cookie. Verified (1) Landing — RetOps shield+gold-O logo, gold 'Sign in with Google' CTA, Instrument Serif display, light hero with navy Command Overview preview card (readable), ROI calculator + navy/gold With-RetOps result card; (2) /dashboard/ai-scoring — 4 KPI cards (AI agents=2, Avg AI score=79.5, Hallucinations=1, Policy failures=0), AI agents list shows Support Bot v3 and Sales Chat AI with avg_score, Quality Gate stream shows AI interactions with SEND/BLOCK verdict pills + score (77/100 Summit Logistics → BLOCK; 82/100 PineRidge → SEND), nav item present between All Interactions and Coaching Hub, SOON pills visible on Coaching Automation/Multilingual/Vertical Packs; (3) /dashboard/playbook — Acme Corp row selected, Public Share card with 'Create public link' button generates link 'https://…/share/p/487a3d0103b94c25' rendered in readonly input alongside Copy/Open; toast 'Public link ready' fires; (4) /share/p/<valid-token> rendered fully unauthenticated (cookies cleared) — RetOps logo, 'SHARED BY RETOPS' label, customer name (Acme Corp), ARR/at risk, Steps with numbered navy circles, Talking points with teal checkmarks, Recommended offer navy card with gold accent, 'Book a demo' CTA present, 'Visit RetOps' gold button in header; (5) /share/p/invalid_xxxx renders 'Link unavailable' graceful page with Visit RetOps button. Contrast and palette look correct (navy + gold + teal) across every screen visited. Regression: all previously-tested endpoints still pass.

issues: After clicking Copy on the share link, no explicit 'Copied' text toast is rendered (only the earlier 'Public link ready' toast from Create). A visual icon swap may occur, but textual confirmation would be clearer for accessibility.
Repeated ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED / 401 console errors (preview hot-reload websocket + pre-auth /auth/me probe). Carry-over from prior iterations, non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional UX) On ChurnSavePlaybook Copy button, show a 'Copied' text or toast for ~1.5s so the copy action has an accessible textual confirmation — currently only an icon swap is inferred.

(Optional data) REWRITE verdict pill path cannot be exercised on current seed data: both seeded AI interactions score 77 (→ BLOCK) and 82 (→ SEND); none land in the REWRITE band. Consider seeding one AI interaction in the 80–89 range, OR confirming the AIAgentScoring verdict thresholds (SEND/REWRITE/BLOCK cut-offs) match the intended demo story.

(Optional data) /api/shared/playbook/{token} for Acme currently returns churn_risk='Low' because the most-recent Acme interaction in DB is the routine billing test created by pytest, which overrides the original seeded high-risk interaction. For a truly high-risk demo link, either POST /api/seed-demo?force=true right before the share, or scope share tokens to a specific interaction_id rather than 'latest for customer'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/shared/playbook/{token} resolves the playbook via 'latest interaction for that customer', so the shared link can drift over time as new interactions land (e.g., a routine follow-up can demote a 'High' churn account to 'Low' on the shared page). Consider snapshotting interaction_id at share-creation time, or exposing the interaction_id on the share so the public view is stable.

/api/playbooks/share/{customer} uses uuid4().hex[:16] for the token — 64 bits of entropy is fine for demo share links, but if this becomes a permanent feature, add a DB unique-index on token and handle collision explicitly.

playbook_shares docs are keyed by (customer, created_by) — two different users sharing the same customer will get different tokens, which is correct, but there is no index on token for O(log n) lookup; add a unique index.

server.py is now ~660 lines — still under the 700-line split threshold flagged last iteration but approaching it; plan to extract routers (auth, interactions, executive, playbook_share) before it grows further.

AIAgentScoring page's verdict pill thresholds (SEND/REWRITE/BLOCK) should be explicitly documented / colocated with the backend scoring rubric so the gate verdict shown on the UI matches backend policy; right now the mapping appears to live only in the frontend.
